subject: Rename 'redis' to 'server' functions missing (#203)
reason: The change is a pure rename refactor: redisIsSupervised becomes serverIsSupervised in server.c and the redisConfig struct with getRedisConfig/freeRedisConfig becomes serverConfig with getServerConfig/freeServerConfig in valkey-benchmark.c. All call sites are updated and no function body, logic, reply, or config semantics change; any error would be a compile failure, not a runtime behavior difference, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
